bullets.text: Companywide CR 89.0 despite volatile weather; PL CR 89.6; CL CR 88.7 (improved 10.4 pts YOY on rate and underwriting actions); Property CR reached an excellent 78.5.

Catastrophes added 4.0 pts to companywide CR, including 3.1 from Helene; Helene contributed 21 Property loss ratio pts; Milton Property losses were estimated at ~$140M net of reinsurance; PL/CL losses estimated ~$600M.
Companywide NPW grew 25%; PL NPW +29% to $16.3B from more new apps, renewal increases, and higher average premiums; CL NPW +7%; Property NPW +9%, primarily in less volatile weather states.
Added nearly 4.2M PIFs companywide since year-end 2023; PL PIFs rose over 1.4M in Q3 to 29.3M (+15% YOY); Property PIFs exceeded 3.4M (+14% YOY), led by renters.
Investment portfolio returned 4.0% (fixed income 3.9%, equity 5.8%); debt-to-total capital fell to 20.2%, well below the <30% internal target; no debt maturities scheduled until 2027.

With rate adequacy across most states, Progressive continued lifting 2023 underwriting and verification restrictions; Property rates increased 6% in Q3 (~20% across trailing four quarters) to address short- and long-term profitability.

Personal auto model 8.9 reached 14 states (35% auto PIFs, 32% trailing 12-month written premiums); commercial auto 8.2 active in nine states; newest BOP model deployed in 24 states; Property 5.0 reached 15 states.

Advertising spend increased above previous quarters; agent compensation programs were leveraged to drive consideration and reward writing profitable business; Direct and Agency channels both experienced record quoting volumes and new business applications.

Personal Lines non-CAT claims showed favorable loss trends with lower frequency consistent with prior quarters; Property's 21 Helene loss ratio points were offset by nearly 30 points of favorable development on first-half storms.

Claims employees exemplified Core Values by aiding a stranded motorist and helping someone secure a policy off the clock; Progressive awarded $1M in small-business vehicle grants and gifted a Freightliner to a veteran.
